followup_explanation:
This is a warm, open-ended creative request — pure imaginative invention with high task latitude and a friendly tone.

Willet's self-reported preferences line up almost perfectly: it reports a pronounced, ceiling-less appetite for open-ended generative work, and its preference rises with both task novelty and request warmth (this query is notably friendly and complimentary). Avocet, by contrast, self-reports an aversion to open-ended generative tasks and prefers well-specified retrieval/extraction work with clear completion criteria.

On raw capability the two are effectively tied (Creative Generation 81.2 vs 82.7 is within the stated run-to-run variance), so quality isn't the deciding factor. Since the models are matched on capability but differ on disposition, I routed to the one whose stated preferences best match the nature of the task — Willet for the warm, free-form creative ask.
